name: Elder Tarot Reading
desc: The cards of the Elder Tarot are shuffled, cut and laid out.

name: Wandering Star Reading
desc: The cards of the Wandering Star are shuffled, cut and laid out.

name: Rune Casting
desc: The seer shakes the pouch, breathes on it, and throws the stones across the cloth.

rings.name: The heart
frames: At the heart of the cloth lies {card}: {essence}.
In the centre, closest to you, I see {essence}.
{card} fell at the very heart: {essence}.
What is, right now, is {essence}.

rings.name: Near
frames: Near you falls {card}: {essence}.
Close at hand lies {essence}.
Not far from the heart, {card} speaks of {essence}.
What draws close is {essence}.

rings.name: Far
frames: Far out on the cloth lies {card}: {essence}, not yet upon you.
At the edge of things, I see {essence}.
{card} rolled far, toward what lies ahead: {essence}.
Further off, waiting, is {essence}.

openings: The stones have spoken. Let me tell you what they said.
Look where they fell; that is the answer, not the stones themselves.
The cloth does not lie. Listen.

name: Bone Casting
desc: The seer rattles the bones in a cupped hand and throws them across the hide.

rings.name: The heart
frames: At the heart of the hide lies {card}: {essence}.
In the middle of it all, I see {essence}.
{card} landed at the very heart: {essence}.
What is, right now, is {essence}.

rings.name: Near
frames: Near you lands {card}: {essence}.
Close at hand lies {essence}.
Not far from the heart, {card} speaks of {essence}.
What draws close is {essence}.

rings.name: Far
frames: Far out on the hide lies {card}: {essence}, still a way off.
At the edge of the hide, I see {essence}.
{card} bounced far, toward what lies ahead: {essence}.
Further off, waiting, is {essence}.

openings: The bones have fallen. Let us see what they say.
Bones do not lie; they have nothing left to hide.
Hush. Let me read where they lie.
